Nvidia's requirements for RISC-V CPUs go beyond the RISC-V profile or platform specifications, and they find it difficult to make CUDA software work well without these features. This move could open the door for RISC-V CPUs to support GPU compute, and could have implications for the development of RISC-V-based systems.
